run_explorer_jobs: run the explorer function to launch SLURM jobs for fair EEG vs MEG comparison across audio datasets
configure_slurm_launcher: configure the SLURM launcher with 2 GPUs and 200 MB per GPU on the learnlab partition
bind_dataset_selections: bind dataset selections like audio_mous, gwilliams2022, or broderick2019 to the launcher with specific seeds
subsample_meg_channels: subsample MEG channels to 128 for fair comparison across all audio datasets
run_mel_spectrum_experiment: run an experiment using MelSpectrum features with the clip_conv model and MSE loss
